00:00:45 Priya Menon: I'll jump in on the infra side — we've got three levers: batching, KV prefix caching rollouts, and quantization profiles. batching changes already reduced the p95 token cost by about 12% in the test pool, but there are latency regressions we need to contain.
00:01:10 Marcus Lee: Right, the latency regressions are real when sequence lengths vary. early kernels are strong for short contexts, but we need dynamic kernel selection more robustly. teams are prototyping auto-switch at runtime.
00:01:29 Sofia Ramirez: Product ask here is that we maintain one API contract across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private. customers don't want surface area differences. roadmap: we plan incremental parity milestones — first with embeddings and basic generation, then chat function calls.
00:01:48 Evan Cole: On the GTM side, Dedicated is selling to mid-market accounts as a predictable economics story. There's interest from a couple of regulated customers for Private. we'll need faster security artifacts to close.
00:02:05 Jordan Park: People update — hiring bandwidth is slower than we'd like; interview conversion rates down a touch. there's also a retention note: folks are asking for clearer career ladders.
00:02:22 Avery Zhang: Thank you, Jordan. For leadership asks: everyone should be able to answer, in 2 lines, what success looks like for their squad next quarter. we'll collect those.

00:02:42 Marcus Lee: SOC2 audit in progress; control evidence pack is mostly complete except a couple of change management artifacts. expecting final audit by mid-June, knock on wood.
00:02:56 Sofia Ramirez: Also ISO exploratory work is underway — this is not blocking sales but helps enterprise prospects.
00:03:09 Priya Menon: On incidents — we had a P0 last month from a model eviction bug in dedicated pool. SRE ran a hotfix, but the RCA shows a race in our KV cache invalidation. Marcus's team has a patch and we're adding a pre-flight check in the deploy pipeline.
00:03:32 Marcus Lee: That pre-flight check is in review, won't overpromise, but it should cut that class of incident by most estimates.
00:03:42 Avery Zhang: Good. On costs — Optimize's recommendations are landing well; the field trial reduced customer's unit cost by 18% average. We need to operationalize those recs into a one-click policy for Dedicated customers.
00:03:58 Evan Cole: Customers asked about fallback tiers during capacity shortages. we should have an explicit policy and pricing for soft-fallbacks so customers aren't surprised when we move to a cheaper model variant.
00:04:15 Sofia Ramirez: We'll draft a fallback policy in the next week — product + legal + finance.
00:04:23 Audience QA: "how many new hires this quarter?"
00:04:30 Jordan Park: Target is 28 net new heads, prioritizing infra and customer success, but it's dependent on offers & budget approvals.
00:04:40 Speaker 3: Clarification on Private deployment lead time?

00:05:02 Avery Zhang: Another ask — we need better signals for model regressions. start feeding a small set of production prompts for continuous evals; Research will own the harness.
00:05:16 Sofia Ramirez: We'll identify a baseline promptset, and link it to rollout gates so a model change triggers an auto-roll-back if quality drops beyond a threshold.
00:05:29 Evan Cole: On channel partnerships — marketplaces are interesting but require legal templates. I'll circulate a first draft partner MSA next week.

00:05:54 Priya Menon: Quick tech note — there's a small perf degradation when vector dims exceed 4096 in current kernels. we're evaluating quantized ops that preserve precision.
00:06:10 Marcus Lee: We'll get an experiment out next sprint.
00:06:14 Speaker 4: Any update on support SLAs for Dedicated customers?
00:06:18 Evan Cole: We're proposing 99.9 uptime SLA for paid Dedicated tiers and a 4-hour incident response for P1 with escalation playbooks. pricing will reflect that.
00:06:30 Sofia Ramirez: We'll also publish a playbook for customers describing expected behaviors and fallbacks.
00:06:38 Moderator: We'll open the floor for questions now; please keep them concise.

00:06:50 Avery Zhang: Three measurable things: 1) reduce p95 token cost by at least 15% across hosted workloads, 2) ship Private onboarding automation to reduce lead time to 5 weeks, 3) close three Dedicated contracts at >$Xk MRR each. That's the high-level signal.
00:07:16 Priya Menon: And ops success: cut incident blast radius with the new pre-flight checks and rollout gates.
